canonicalisation.name: nested objects sorted at every level
key above U+FFFF sorts by code point, not UTF-16 code unit
negative exponent uses ECMAScript form, not zero-padded
decomposed key is normalised to NFC before sorting
a float with an integral value serialises as an integer (95.0)
exponent input below 1e21 serialises in full (1e15)
small numbers use ECMAScript exponent form (1.5e-7)
the largest safe integer, written as a float
a surrogate pair written as escapes is one character
